Production Employee 5-Shift System Zevenaar

As a production employee in a 5-shift system in Zevenaar, you will work in a dynamic environment where no days are the same.

In this role, you are responsible for ensuring the smooth running of the production process. You start your day with a brief handover from the previous shift, after which you operate and check the machines. Throughout the day, you monitor the quality of the products and resolve any issues. You ensure that the products are packed and prepared for shipment.

You will be working at a leading manufacturing company in Zevenaar. The organization is known for its innovative approach and strong focus on quality. With a team of committed employees, they strive to deliver the best products. The work atmosphere is informal and focused on collaboration, with plenty of room for personal development. 

Requirements

- MBO/ vocational working and thinking level
- Experience in a production environment
- Forklift and reach truck certificate is a plus
- Team-oriented collaboration
- Good communication skills
- Problem-solving ability
- Knowledge of safety regulations
- Good command of Dutch or English

- Salary €17.50 per hour excluding shift allowance
- Full-time employment
- Working in a 5-shift system
- Travel allowance
- Holiday pay

PROPELLING INNOVATION WITH YOU!!!!  
  
 Would you like to join one of the best specialized PLM consulting and system integration firm that works closely with its clients to accelerate business transformation using its unique approach based in product lifecycle management (PLM) - which combines consulting, integration and managed services?  
  
 If yes, this position is for YOU!!!  
  
 As part of our current growth, we are looking for an HR assistant for Europe Zone
 

Job Description
 
 

• Work with lead HR Europe, based in France (Paris), to manage all cross countries HR processes and provide operational & administrative support  
 

• Countries: France, UK, Belgium, Netherlands, Sweden 

• Consolidate the Performance Management cycle data at Europe level – Build & contribute to run all the related HR plans (annual assessment interviews, salary reviews, development plans, training plans)  

• Prepare all appropriate HR documents such as letter, employment contracts and ad hoc correspondences  

• Support the HR Personal administration tasks and lead some of the processes with external partners / providers (payroll coordination, follow up on fringe benefits, individual files,…) and maintain all the HR tracking database (Training plan, work permits, medical checkup, Health Insurance registration, Paid leaves….) 

• Support and run the onboarding process for new comers in the countries  

• Ensure the Processia HR academy regular follow up (eLearning platform) and propose appropriate communication to promote the content 

• Contribute to some HR transversal initiatives and team projects  

The Successful Applicant
 
 

• Job Skills  
 

• At least 3 years of relevant experience in HR in France, UK, Belgium or Netherlands. Ideally familiar with French social legislation 

• Small and fast-paced environment/companies first experience (“PME”) 

• Strong computer skills (Excel and Powerpoint as a must).  

• Fluent French and English, good knowledge of Dutch would be a plus   

·
 Behavioral skills: 
 

- Excellent interpersonal and communication skills, ability to build solid relationships with employees, positive open attitude, team spirit.
 

- Autonomy, willingness and ability to work remotely
 

- Flexibility to deal with last minute changes, can-do attitude, problem solver, ability to remain calm under pressure

Connaissance Générales et Ressources Humaines

Lead the design, development, and optimization of enterprise applications across back-end and front-end technologies. Architect scalable solutions, apply advanced software design patterns, and mentor junior and medior developers. Utilize the Microsoft ecosystem, modern front-end frameworks, Azure cloud services, messaging platforms, and architectural practices like CQRS, DDD, and Clean Architecture to deliver robust and business-aligned solutions.

• Architect and design scalable enterprise applications

• Build interactive user interfaces with modern front-end frameworks (Angular, Blazor, React)

• Collaborate with product owners and business analysts to translate requirements into technical solutions

• Implement and optimize containerized solutions with Kubernetes, Docker, or AKS

• Design and integrate distributed systems using messaging Middleware (Azure Service Bus, RabbitMQ, Kafka)

• Leverage Azure services for cloud-native, scalable, and secure solutions

• Ensure CI/CD pipelines, automated testing, and DevOps best practices

Very good knowledge in the following technologies is a plus

• C#

• .NET Core

• ASP.NET Core

• Entity Framework Core

• LINQ

• RESTful API design and integration

• SQL Server

• MicroServices architecture

• CQRS

• DDD

• Clean Architecture principles

• Blazor or Angular

• TypeScript

• JavaScript

• Unit & integration testing

• CI/CD pipelines

• Microsoft Azure

• Kubernetes

• Docker

• AKS

• WPF (XAML) is a plus

• Problem-solving

• Rigorous methodology

Qualifications

• 5+ years in .NET / .NET Core development

• Master's or Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or related field is a plus

• English + French and / or Dutch

Are you passionate about transport and logistics? Bleckmann is looking for you! 

We are looking for logistics employees for the Bleckmann warehouses in Rieme and Desteldonk (near Ghent) to support the Black Friday sale from 16 November until 14 December.. You will be working in the morning shift (05u48 - 13u48).

This is a temporary assignment during a busy and dynamic peak period. It's a great opportunity to gain experience in logistics. As Bleckmann operates multiple peak periods throughout the year, you will have the opportunity to return for future assignments.

Are you interested in this opportunity? Be sure to read this vacancy!

• Pick up at Sint-Jansplein 

• Departure at 4u30

 

• Positive attitude

• Good numerical skills

• Flexibility

• Punctuality

The job

You will be working from Monday to Friday: 7h30 - 15h36 or 14h00 -22h06 (with a half hour break)

We are looking for packing employees who can work in three shifts and would like to work in the food industry in Dendermonde.

You will work in the packing department of a company that specializes in packing frozen products. You will work in a refrigerated environment (around 10 degrees Celsius).

• Checking the quality of products

• Packing all kinds of products (e.g. fish, snacks, vegetables, ...) in boxes or bags

• Sticking labels

• Stacking boxes on pallets

• Close communication with the operator

• ...

• You have previous experience in a production environment and can work flexible in three shifts.

• You do not mind performing physical work at pace.

• You have a good knowledge of the Dutch or English language in case of safety instructions.

• As the company is located in an industrial zone, it is not accessible by public transport. You can travel each day independently to Dendermonde.

• You are looking for long-term employment and do not mind performing a 2h packing test after a positive job interview.

Our client is a wholesale company based in Sint-Katelijne-Waver, specialized in the distribution of fresh fruit and vegetables in Belgium and the Netherlands.

For decades, this wholesale organization has been active in the fresh produce sector, using its knowledge and experience every day to search for opportunities, innovations, and top-quality products.

They can rightfully call themselves a leading player in the distribution, import, and export of fruit and vegetables.

Would you like to be part of their team?

Our client is looking for a motivated CE truck driver!

• Holder of a CE driving license with valid Code 95.
• Hard worker, committed to your job, with respect for customers, colleagues, and entrusted equipment.
• Not afraid of loading and unloading yourself.
• You will be the company’s calling card.

Does this sound like the right opportunity for you?

Send us your CV today, and we’ll get to work for you!

REF:MEC

• CE driving license.
• Code 95.
• Initial experience in distribution is an asset.
• Willing to work occasionally on Saturdays.
• Flexible, customer-oriented, and punctual.
• Flexible availability for both day and night shifts (both are required).
• Good knowledge of Dutch or French and English (understanding, writing, and speaking).

Production Operator with Technical Insight Wanted in Kampenhout!

Do you have experience in a production environment and enjoy taking responsibility?

This company, located in Kampenhout, is a leading producer and supplier of professional fluids for the automotive and industrial sectors.

From this site, they manufacture a wide range of maintenance, cleaning, and consumable products for workshops and garages.

To strengthen their team, they are looking for a Production Operator with technical insight who enjoys working independently and taking responsibility for an entire production line.

Your Challenge

As a Production Operator, you will be responsible for correctly setting up, converting, starting, and operating the production line.

You will ensure that every product is manufactured and filled according to the required specifications.

Your Responsibilities

Production Line Changeovers

• Adjusting and converting the production line according to technical specifications.
• Changing packaging materials, caps, labels, and boxes.
• Setting up printing information on bottles, cans, and boxes.
• Selecting the correct production programs and parameters.
• Starting up the production line.

Filling and Production

• Interpreting and following technical specifications and work instructions.
• Checking materials at the production line.
• Replenishing labels, packaging materials, and other production supplies.
• Manually packing finished products into boxes.
• Performing quality checks on weight, dosage, and product finish.
• Adjusting and fine-tuning machine settings when necessary.
• Monitoring the supply and flow of liquids throughout the process.
• Connecting new tanks to the production system.

Technical Follow-Up

• Detecting malfunctions and assisting in resolving them together with the technician.
• Reporting accurately to the Production Manager.
• Ensuring quality, safety, and efficiency throughout the production process.

REF:MEC1

• You have experience working on a production line.
• You work in a highly responsible and detail-oriented manner, with a strong focus on quality and safety.
• You are organized and tidy; you remove production waste and clean your workstation before handing it over to colleagues on the next shift.
• You are hands-on and capable of lifting and handling heavy objects with ease.
• You are eager to learn and support your colleagues; a technical background or education in mechanics or electrical/electronics engineering is a strong advantage, whether completed or not.
• You are dynamic and able to perform well under pressure.
• You are flexible and willing to work in different shifts (6:00 AM – 2:00 PM / 2:00 PM – 10:00 PM) and/or in the day shift (8:00 AM – 4:00 PM), depending on production needs. The same flexibility applies to overtime.
• You are fluent in Dutch, French, or English.

CE Driver Wanted in the Port of Antwerp

For a logistics company located in the Port of Antwerp, we are looking for an experienced and motivated CE Driver.

As a driver, you will be responsible for the safe and timely transport of bulk goods and containers to and from various locations in and around the port. You will join a professional transport environment where safety, punctuality and clear communication are key.

What will you do?

• You are responsible for container transport to and from the Port of Antwerp.
• You collect containers from terminals and deliver them to customers.
• You carry out national transport, mainly within Belgium and the surrounding region.
• You check the load and ensure that containers are properly and safely secured.
• You ensure the correct handling of transport documents.
• You stay in contact with the planning department and communicate any problems or delays.
• You comply with the applicable safety regulations in the port.
• You are responsible for the proper inspection and care of your truck and trailer.

You will mainly work from the Port of Antwerp and carry out predominantly national and regional routes.

Interested?

Apply today and discover whether this position as a CE Driver in the Port of Antwerp is the right opportunity for you!

REF: MEC1

• You have a valid CE driving licence and Code 95
• Previous experience with container transport is preferred.
• Experience driving in the Port of Antwerp is a strong advantage.
• An  ADR certificate is a strong advantage.
• You are a safe and responsible driver.
• You are punctual, reliable and customer-oriented.
• You can work independently, while communicating smoothly with the planning department.
• You are flexible and have no problem with the dynamic nature of port and transport work.
• You have a sufficient level of  English to communicate smoothly.

This Belgian manufacturer of dry powder mixtures for the construction industry (mortars, adhesives, plasters, etc.), located in the Port of Antwerp, is looking to strengthen its current team with a motivated OPERATOR.

As an OPERATOR, you will be responsible for all operational tasks required during your shift for production and loading activities. You will play a crucial role in the production process and will be widely deployable across various production lines, from mixing processes to bagging.

Your responsibilities as an OPERATOR* will include:

• Preparing, weighing and accurately dosing raw materials and additives for mixing processes, particularly liquids.
• Monitoring and operating mixing and filling machines, such as dissolvers, mixing tanks and filling equipment.
• Operating, converting and setting up bagging machines.
• Setting up and loading packaging materials (e.g. film) onto the machines.
• Carrying out process checks and visual inspections of the finished product, such as checking viscosity and colour consistency.
• Replacing simple mechanical components on the production lines.
• Processing residual product and cleaning the factory, including cleaning mixing equipment and pipelines.
• Assisting drivers during loading operations.
• Carrying out internal transport and logistical activities using a forklift and/or reach truck.

REF:MEC1

Experience & Profile

• You have proven relevant work experience as an OPERATOR in a production environment.
• Experience with mixing, dispersing or filling liquids, or operating bagging and packaging machines, is preferred.
• A valid forklift and/or reach truck certificate is a major advantage.
• You are familiar with terminology and techniques used in the mixing industry, such as batch production, dosing and basic quality control
• You have a technical aptitude and a strong problem-solving mindset.
• You are communicative and have a good command of Dutch or English

Nice to have

jobs.occupation: Store Assistant / Sales Associate – Christmas Shop | Bruges | Full-Time
jobs.description:
Do you enjoy working in a welcoming retail environment and love the magic of Christmas? Do you enjoy helping customers find the perfect decorations for the holiday season?

For a unique Christmas store in the heart of Bruges, we are looking for an enthusiastic Store Assistant / Sales Associate who will help customers bring the Christmas spirit into their homes.

What will you do?
As a Sales Associate, you will be the face of the store and ensure that every customer enjoys a warm and pleasant shopping experience.

Your responsibilities include:

• Welcoming and assisting customers in a friendly manner
• Advising customers on Christmas decorations, ornaments, gifts and seasonal products
• Maintaining an attractive and organized store presentation
• Restocking shelves and keeping the store clean and tidy
• Processing payments and handling cash register duties
• Assisting with deliveries and unpacking new merchandise

• You enjoy working with customers and providing excellent service
• You are willing to work weekends on a rotating schedule
• Previous retail or sales experience is an advantage
• You speak Spanish, Dutch or English fluently
• In addition to your strongest language, you can communicate at a basic level in at least one of the other languages
• You enjoy working in an international environment with tourists and visitors from different countries
• You are enthusiastic, reliable and enjoy working as part of a team

You will support the Customer Service team with tasks such as order entry, stock assignment, requests of certificates, etc.

 As you will progress in your training, the responsibilities can be expanded to direct customer support and coordination of the full order to cash process for a selected amount of customers.

• Act as a key point of contact for assigned customers and provide professional and timely support.
• Manage the end-to-end order process, including order entry, verification, delivery coordination and invoicing.
• Maintain accurate customer and order information in the systems.
• Provide customers and Sales colleagues with clear updates on order and delivery status.
• Prepare relevant documentation, including order confirmations, delivery documents and certificates.
• Respond to customer inquiries and help resolve order, delivery, pricing or product-related questions.
• Register and follow up on customer complaints, returns and other order-related issues.
• Work closely with Sales and internal stakeholders to ensure an efficient customer experience.
• Collaborate with colleagues across Customer Service, Supply Chain, Sales, Quality and other departments.
 

• You have experience in Customer Service, Sales Support, Order Management, Administration or a similar environment. 
• You are customer-focused, organized and comfortable managing different priorities and administrative tasks.
• You communicate clearly and enjoy working with customers and colleagues from different countries and cultures.
• You are confident working with Microsoft Excel, Outlook and Teams.
• Experience with SAP or another ERP system is considered a strong advantage.
• You are fluent in English, both spoken and written.
• Knowledge of Russian is an additional asset, but is not required.
• You work accurately, take ownership and enjoy contributing to a collaborative team environment.

Inetum is a European leader in digital services. Every day, the Group's 28,000 consultants and specialists aim to make a digital impact for businesses, public sector bodies and society as a whole: solutions that contribute to performance, innovation and the common good.

Present in 19 countries, close to the regions, and with its major software publisher partners, Inetum meets the challenges of digital transformation with proximity and flexibility.

In response to a market that has been growing steadily for over 30 years, Inetum has made the deliberate choice to refocus on 4 core businesses in order to gain strength and offer customized solutions tailored to the specific needs of its customers: consulting (Inetum Consulting), infrastructure and application management (Inetum Technologies), software implementation (Inetum Solutions) and its own software publishing business (Inetum Software). Inetum has forged strategic partnerships with 4 of the world's leading software publishers - Salesforce, ServiceNow, Microsoft and SAP - and is pursuing a dedicated acquisition strategy to become one of Europe's top 5 in these technologies, and offer the best expertise to its customers.

At Inetum Belgium, we offer more than just a job; we provide an inspiring environment and opportunities for growth and development. We strive to create a workplace where you can harness your talents, contribute to challenging projects, and be part of a leading IT consultancy group.

Job Description

Forget about conventional communication styles, the main language we speak is Java. So, If you are looking to upgrade your skills and working on exciting and challenging projects; just scroll down your mouse and learn how you can become the next Java developer Expert Inetum-Belgium is searching for.

As Java developer it will be expected of you:

 
• To share and upgrade your skills through multiple projects ranging from new applications & functionalities developments to complex cross-projects developments. Including elaboration and contribution to maintenance standards.
 
• To share you expertise and exchange about projects status and issues during the Scrum meetings.
 
• To help identify and bring your contribution to key improvements elements of development projects.
 
• To take the lead on the quality of the delivery by playing a proactive role in the testing phases at all the necessary steps of the development.
 
• To ensure the delivery of well designed, testable and efficient code
 
• To coach and help junior profiles on some matters (if you feel comfortable)

Discover your future with inetum belgium

• Achieve Work-Life Balance: we value your well-being. Enjoy flexible working hours, the convenience of satellite offices, the comfort of home working, and an informal, no-nonsense environment.
 
• Enjoy Generous Annual Leave: life is more than just work. Take advantage of 32 days of annual leave to relax and recharge.
 
• Travel in Comfort: forget the hassle of commuting. We provide a company car and a national fuel/charging card to keep you on the move. Prefer a different option? You can choose a mobility allowance instead
